pages.text: Darts are an alternate ranged weapon. All darts require a matching dart shooter, fire very quickly, are unaffected by gravity, and deal significantly less damage than arrows.$(br2)Golden darts are the basic variety of dart, easily crafted in both the Twilight Forest and Aether.

In the Aether, darts can be enchanted in an $(thing)Altar$() using ambrosium, enhancing their power! You'll also need to enchant a matching dart shooter to use them.$(br2)Lastly, darts can be poisoned, making them inflict $(thing)Inebriation$() on their targets. Bosses are immune to this effect, but a single dart will incapacitate most monsters.
